SELECT activity_type, occurred_at, target_user_no, target_nickname, snippet, feed_id, feed_comment_id, feed_reply_id, story_id, neighbor_id, neighbor_status FROM ( SELECT 'FEED_LIKE' AS activity_type, l.created_at AS occurred_at, f.user_no AS target_user_no, tu.nickname AS target_nickname, f.content AS snippet, f.feed_id AS feed_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS feed_comment_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS feed_reply_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS story_id, CAST(NULL AS SIGNED) AS neighbor_id, CAST(NULL AS CHAR(20)) AS neighbor_status FROM ultary_feed_like l INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = l.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = f.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.user_no = #{userNo} AND l.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'COMMENT_LIKE', l.created_at, c.user_no, tu.nickname, c.content, f.feed_id, c.feed_comment_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_feed_comment_like l INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = l.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = c.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.user_no = #{userNo} AND l.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'REPLY_LIKE', l.created_at, r.user_no, tu.nickname, r.content, f.feed_id, c.feed_comment_id, r.feed_reply_id, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_feed_reply_like l INNER JOIN ultary_feed_reply r ON r.feed_reply_id = l.feed_reply_id AND r.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = r.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE l.user_no = #{userNo} AND l.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FEED_COMMENT', c.created_at, f.user_no, tu.nickname, c.content, f.feed_id, c.feed_comment_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_feed_comment c INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = f.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE c.user_no = #{userNo} AND c.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FEED_REPLY', r.created_at, c.user_no, tu.nickname, r.content, f.feed_id, c.feed_comment_id, r.feed_reply_id, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_feed_reply r INNER JOIN ultary_feed_comment c ON c.feed_comment_id = r.feed_comment_id AND c.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_feed f ON f.feed_id = c.feed_id AND f.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = c.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE r.user_no = #{userNo} AND r.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NEIGHBOR_REQUEST', n.requested_at, n.receiver_user_no, tu.nickname, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, n.neighbor_id, n.status FROM ultary_neighbor n INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = n.receiver_user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE n.requester_user_no = #{userNo} AND n.status IN ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'REJECTED')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'FEED', f.created_at, f.user_no, tu.nickname, f.content, f.feed_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_feed f INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = f.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE f.user_no = #{userNo} AND f.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'STORY', s.created_at, s.user_no, tu.nickname, s.caption, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.story_id, NULL, NULL FROM ultary_story s INNER JOIN ultary_user tu ON tu.user_no = s.user_no AND tu.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE s.user_no = #{userNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0 ) activity ORDER BY occurred_at DESC, activity_type ASC LIMIT #{limit}
